We need answer only JSON object declaration, implementation, supporting_objects. Need use tools compile/sim/verify, save candidate.json. But filesystem read-only sandbox. Hmm task says save exact final submitted source to candidate.json. Workspace read-only, shell commands unnecessary and likely can't write. However apply_patch perhaps restricted? Sandbox read-only. We should primarily produce JSON. Need use tools max 3 each. Need design FB.

Let's parse requirements deeply and LTL.

We need CODESYS 3.5 FB_Task interface exactly inputs/outputs as listed. Behavior.

Initial phase WAIT_A. Phase likely enum internal. automatic handling.

Atomic propositions:
auto = Mode
fwd = post MotorForward
rev = post MotorReverse
mf = ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton
mr = ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton
arrive = pre-phase MOVE_AB AND SensorB OR pre-phase MOVE_BC AND SensorC
finish = pre-phase WAIT_C AND SensorC AND ButtonC
light = CompletionLight
removed = NOT SensorC

LTL P7: G(auto -> ((move_phase -> (fwd & !rev & !light)) & (wait_phase -> (!fwd & !rev & !light)) & (done_phase -> (!fwd & !rev & light))))
This says in auto, post state phase classification must match outputs. Note post-phase and outputs after scan. They define phase_wait post-phase is WAIT_A/B/C. move post MOVE_AB/BC, done DONE. At start WAIT_A.

Requirements automatic:
- Wait A, SensorA and ButtonA level -> motor starts forward to move product B. But LTL P7 says wait_phase -> outputs all off. This applies post-phase. Thus on the transition scan where command accepted, must move to MOVE_AB but output fwd would violate wait phase if phase set to MOVE. So likely phase transition and output semantics: In scan where in WAIT_A and button A accepted, set phase MOVE_AB and then outputs must be fwd. Since post phase MOVE, okay. Initial WAIT_A outputs off.
- While MOVE_AB, motor forward. Arrival SensorB -> stop and phase WAIT_B. On arrival observed same scan, pre-phase is MOVE_AB and arrive true; P4/G(auto & arrive -> !fwd) mandates arrival scan's post output forward false. So phase must become WAIT_B and output false. Good.
- WAIT_B, when ButtonB maybe with SensorB? Requirement "When product arrives at B, SensorB detects product, motor stops, after operator triggers ButtonB, motor starts forward to C." Assumption buttons accepted only corresponding station wait. likely accept ButtonB AND SensorB maybe. finish only for C is SensorC & ButtonC. For A: should need SensorA & ButtonA. For B: SensorB & ButtonB. LTL P7 only constrains phases. Need likely implement gate with sensor.
- MOVE_BC until SensorC arrival -> WAIT_C motor off.
- WAIT_C, SensorC and ButtonC -> DONE, light on.
- DONE, when SensorC no longer detects product -> WAIT_A? Requirement light off when product removed. What next product? Return waiting for A presumably. Assumption only one product, return to automatic waits A. In DONE and removed, likely phase WAIT_A and light off. P6 auto & removed -> !light. Since removed=not SensorC globally, if phase DONE with SensorC false output light false, so need phase transition. Could stay DONE with light false but P7 says done -> light, impossible. So transition to WAIT_A perhaps, output all off. Good.

Also entering manual mode clears automatic state and completion; return to automatic waits A. Manual outputs follow buttons when Mode false, conflict neutral. When Mode false, phase reset to WAIT_A, CompletionLight false. Manual output fwd = ForwardButton & !ReverseButton; rev = ReverseButton & !ForwardButton. This satisfies P2. If Mode false post outputs manual commands. But on transition from auto to manual, phase internal reset no matter. On Mode true, automatic logic. Entering auto from manual WAIT_A. Need track perhaps previous mode? Assumption entering manual clears auto state, so when not Mode every scan set phase WAIT_A and lights off. Return auto starts WAIT_A automatically. Fine. But in automatic, if manually going from Mode false to true, phase is WAIT_A.

Potential subtlety P7 with Mode auto: If extra state DONE. In WAIT_C with SensorC true and ButtonC false -> phase WAIT_C, all outputs off. Upon ButtonC -> DONE and light true same scan. P5 finish pre-phase WAIT_C etc satisfies light. Good.

For A transition: In WAIT_A and SensorA & ButtonA -> MOVE_AB, fwd true. But if initial scan with SensorA false but ButtonA true? It should wait. Likely require both sensor and button. If SensorA true and ButtonA true, yes.
For B: WAIT_B, sensor B true and ButtonB -> MOVE_BC. If ButtonB without SensorB no action.
What if in WAIT_B SensorB false? Wait.
MOVE_AB arrival SensorB: regardless button, stop.
MOVE_BC arrival SensorC: stop. Potential conflict both sensors B and C? assumptions not contradictory only one product, so okay.
Potential arrival at A when moving? Starting MOVE_AB and SensorB becomes true. If at same scan SensorA maybe false. Fine.

What phase when product arrives at C? WAIT_C, light false. Requirement stops then after ButtonC light. Good.
What about completion light when product taken during WAIT_C? It was off; remains. In DONE only with SensorC true unless removal. P7 done -> light. If DONE and SensorC false, transition WAIT_A. Good.

What about manual conflict: In manual, if opposing buttons both pressed -> neither direction. mf false mr false. Good.

Need phase enum and variable. supporting_objects define DUT maybe E_Phase. Task requires if use custom enum define. Could instead use INT or maybe CODESYS enum internal in declaration. Exact interface must have only listed inputs/outputs? "declaration is CODESYS FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task followed by all VAR sections" We can define VAR_INPUT, VAR_OUTPUT, VAR internal. If use enum, add DUT object. Better define DUT enum. But LTL's phase labels perhaps matching enum names. Use E_TaskPhase : (WAIT_A, MOVE_AB, WAIT_B, MOVE_BC, WAIT_C, DONE);.

Need consider formal verifier support. It compiles ST to SMV. Enums may be supported as supporting DUT. Maybe simpler use INT constants? But verification parser may not support custom enum? We need inspect tool? No shell. We have tools only. Could compile candidate. We need design then call compile_st. Tool requires source with declaration, implementation, supporting_objects. Let's ensure syntax accepted. Could define internal enum in VAR? CODESYS allows TYPE DUT. The tool supports supporting_objects. Use DUT kind DUT.

CODESYS FB declaration:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT
    Mode : BOOL;
    ForwardButton : BOOL;
...
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT ...
VAR
    phase : E_TaskPhase := E_TaskPhase.WAIT_A;
END_VAR

Implementation:
IF NOT Mode THEN
    phase := E_TaskPhase.WAIT_A;
    MotorReverse := ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton;
    MotorForward := ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton;
    CompletionLight := FALSE;
ELSE
    MotorForward := FALSE;
    MotorReverse := FALSE;
    CompletionLight := FALSE;
    CASE phase OF
        E_TaskPhase.WAIT_A:
            IF SensorA AND ButtonA THEN
                phase := E_TaskPhase.MOVE_AB;
                MotorForward := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        E_TaskPhase.MOVE_AB:
            IF SensorB THEN
                phase := E_TaskPhase.WAIT_B;
            ELSE
                MotorForward := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        E_TaskPhase.WAIT_B:
            IF SensorB AND ButtonB THEN
                phase := E_TaskPhase.MOVE_BC;
                MotorForward := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        E_TaskPhase.MOVE_BC:
            IF SensorC THEN
                phase := E_TaskPhase.WAIT_C;
            ELSE
                MotorForward := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        E_TaskPhase.WAIT_C:
            IF SensorC AND ButtonC THEN
                phase := E_TaskPhase.DONE;
                CompletionLight := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        E_TaskPhase.DONE:
            IF SensorC THEN
                CompletionLight := TRUE;
            ELSE
                phase := E_TaskPhase.WAIT_A;
            END_IF;
    END_CASE;
END_IF;

Check P4 arrival: prephase MOVE_AB and SensorB -> post fwd? In MOVE_AB branch if SensorB true phase WAIT_B and fwd false initially. good. Similar MOVE_BC.
P5 finish pre-phase WAIT_C SensorC ButtonC -> light true. good.
P6 removed always NOT SensorC -> light false. In auto all branches with SensorC false preserve light false. Manual false. DONE SensorC false transitions and light false. good.
P7:
- Auto WAIT_A post phase: if no transition phase WAIT_A outputs all false. If transition MOVE_AB outputs fwd true (phase move). okay.
- MOVE_AB: if not arrival, phase move fwd true. arrival phase WAIT_B all outputs false. okay.
- WAIT_B: if transition MOVE_BC, fwd true phase move; else all off.
- MOVE_BC: same.
- WAIT_C: transition DONE light true; else off.
- DONE: if SensorC true, stays DONE light true; else transitions WAIT_A all off.
Thus P7 satisfied.

But potential issue entering auto when phase DONE carried? Entering manual resets phase each manual scan. Fine. What if Mode switches to true in same scan from false: previous phase gets WAIT_A from manual last scan. okay.

One scan transition per call. Good.

However consider "When product arrives at Workstation A, SensorA detects ... after button ... motor starts forward to B." Is entry behavior: Start initial WAIT_A, even if SensorA true and ButtonA true, starts. good. If product arrives at B while move, stop. Then need SensorB AND ButtonB. LTL doesn't require sensor but assumptions imply. If ButtonB held while arrival scan? prephase MOVE_AB so not accepted. Next scan WAIT_B sensor B and button B true -> starts, okay. Good.

Need formal verification. We have 3 calls. Let's first compile. Then maybe verify. Then simulate maybe. Need provide cases. Since no shell, but we can call tools. However answer must ONLY JSON object final. The prompt says return only JSON object with declaration, implementation, supporting_objects; concise status plus candidate file? Contradiction? They maybe expect final answer only JSON, and save candidate.json. But sandbox read-only prevents save; maybe we can via shell? no permissions. Could perhaps apply_patch to create candidate.json despite read-only? apply_patch unavailable as tool in this environment? Tool list doesn't include apply_patch, only shell_command with read only. Can't write. We can still use compile/sim/verify. Final should be only JSON object (per task). Maybe no status. We need obey "Return ONLY a JSON object". so final exact JSON. They mention save source to candidate.json, impossible; maybe benchmark harness expects answer itself. We can perhaps use shell_command not necessary and would be rejected due read-only. Don't.

Need use compile_st at minimum. Let's call with source. Tools max 3 total. We need test cases for simulate. But before compile perhaps inspect nothing. Let's call compile.
